answer: Problem: cheap clone identities can flood grading seats. Mechanism: each newcomer locks 18 POA in a walnut-hard escrow vault for 72 hours; unlock needs five distinct peer vouchers who each stake 2 POA nectar slices that slash on false vouch. Cost: 28 POA locked plus about 90s voucher round-trips. Verification: vouchers must cover three independent join-graph hops and match on-ledger stake hashes before release. Failure: if any voucher is revoked within 24h, the vault burns 6 POA and the agent loses seats until a fresh 72h lock.
